context: Dr. Saito reviews Sachiko's annual checkup with reassurance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 佐知子さん、検査の結果、伺いますね。
lines.en: Sachiko-san, I'd like to go over your test results with you.
lines.style: Warm and composed opening. Gentle but clear—the voice of someone who delivers news regularly and does it well. Unhurried pace. Underlying kindness, no clinical distance.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: はい、お願いします、先生。
lines.style: Quiet anticipation. Respectful without stiffness. A small intake of breath before speaking—the way an elderly person settles into important news. Trustful.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 健康、全体、良好です。安心してください。
lines.en: Overall, your health looks very good. You can rest easy.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring voice. Weight on the word 'good.' Slight pause before the final sentence—letting the reassurance land. Warm without overplaying it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ああ、嬉しい。安心しました。
lines.en: Ah—that's wonderful. I feel so much better.
lines.style: Immediate relief in the voice. Brightness rising on 'wonderful.' Exhale of tension releasing. Genuine, unguarded joy—the kind that comes from good news you needed to hear.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 一つだけ、毎日の散歩、続けて、重要です。
lines.en: One thing that's important: keep up your daily walks.
lines.style: Slight shift to gentle counsel. Light emphasis on 'important'—not stern, just clear. Conversational advice from someone who knows her well enough to speak plainly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: おじいちゃんと、毎日、歩いてます。
lines.en: Oh, my husband and I—we walk every day together.
lines.style: Warmth rising. Pride and affection woven in. Slight smile audible. The voice of someone sharing something that matters—a small life they've built.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 素晴らしい。お二人で、続けてください。
lines.en: That's wonderful. Please keep doing that together.
lines.style: Genuine approval. Soft landing on 'wonderful'—she means it. Closing warmth. The kind of doctor who sees the person, not just the patient.
